client_profiles.label: Desktop / discrete GPU
client_profiles.notes: High-end desktop baseline for upper-bound WebGPU throughput.

client_profiles.label: Android / mid-range SoC
client_profiles.notes: Stress case for mobile memory and frame-time stability.

metric_notes: ttfr_ms/load_ms/bytes/fps/p95_frame_ms/failure_rate/failure_stages come from deployed browser telemetry (/api/telemetry/summary); t50_view_ms/t90_view_ms/chunk_arrival_time/memory_budget_rows come from the policy simulator (run_serving_benchmark.py).

client_adaptation.raise_condition: avg fps >= 1.25 * target_fps while the row cap is binding and chunks remain
client_adaptation.raise_step: cap * 1.5, bounded by scene rows and the desktop tier cap
client_adaptation.lower_step: cap * 0.75, floored at max(200k rows, initial cap * 0.25)
client_adaptation.note: Lowering stops future chunk fetches only; resident rows are never dropped.
